label: The Wedding Speech
summary: Your best friend’s wedding in Larkport is a week away. The speech is yours and still unwritten, and the maid of honor is the person you once left on a night train.
title: The Wedding Speech
description: A week of fittings, rehearsals and a wedding on a river boat. Your best friend needs you calm. The maid of honor needs you to explain why you never came back. The speech needs to be funny.

chapterOutlines.title: Seven Days
chapterOutlines.outline: Arrive in Larkport, meet the wedding party, and see the maid of honor again.

chapterOutlines.title: The Rehearsal
chapterOutlines.outline: Fittings, a disastrous rehearsal dinner and a long walk over eleven bridges.

chapterOutlines.title: The River Boat
chapterOutlines.outline: Give the speech, and say what you came back to say.

scene.location: The arrivals hall of Larkport Central station
scene.summary: Evening, the 6:40 from the north. Your best friend waves from the barrier, and beside him is someone you did not expect to see.

openThreads: What really happened on the night train?
Will the speech be a disaster?

npcs.name: Sol Mendes
npcs.description: Sweet, anxious and convinced something will go wrong.
abilities: Can make anyone feel at home

npcs.name: Harriet Vance
npcs.description: Sharp-tongued, very organized, and not ready to forgive you.
goals: Get through the week without caring
abilities: Plans anything down to the minute
